next.reason: 1985: "Integer-1 specifies the column number of the leftmost character position of the printable item."; 2023: "b) If LEFT is specified, integer-1 is the leftmost column ... c) If RIGHT is specified, integer-1 is the rightmost column". 2023 makes integer-1 the leftmost column only with LEFT. New RIGHT and CENTER phrases make it the rightmost or center column, and the quoted rules state no default.
